description: Create a reusable product (fixed-price checkout template with a public page), or — with kind="charge" — a CHARGE (Portuguese: "cobrança"): a payment link with a due date and optional late fine/interest, for rent, tuition or an instalment. A charge is served at pay.depixapp.com/c/{id} and never appears on the merchant's public store. NOTE: `create_checkout` makes a ONE-OFF payment that is paid once and is short-lived; this tool with kind="charge" makes a STANDING one that has a due date and can recur. Requires scope `merchant_write`.

amount.description: Amount in BRL cents (R$5.00–R$6000.00). Wire field is `amount`.

amount_cents.description: Alias of `amount` (BRL cents). Provide either `amount` or `amount_cents`.

due_date.description: REQUIRED when kind is `charge`. First due date, YYYY-MM-DD, and the anchor of the recurrence. May be in the past — a retroactive charge starts already overdue.

kind.description: `product` (default) = a catalog item on the merchant's public store. `charge` = a payment link with a DUE DATE and optional late fees (rent, tuition, an instalment), served at pay.depixapp.com/c/{id}; it never appears on the store, the cart or the default product listing, and `due_date` becomes required. Immutable after creation.

late_fine_bps.description: Charges only. One-time late fine in basis points of the base amount (200 = 2%). Default 0, max 2000 (20%).

late_interest_monthly_bps.description: Charges only. Monthly interest in basis points, accrued pro-rata per day late (100 = 1% a month). Default 0, max 1000 (10%).

recurrence.description: Charges only. null or omitted = a one-time charge. Monthly and above anchor on the due day, clamping to the last day of shorter months (the 31st becomes Feb 28/29).

slug.description: URL slug (auto-generated from name when omitted).

name: create_product

due_date.description: First due date (charges; null for products).

late_fine_bps.description: One-time late fine in basis points (0 for products).

late_interest_monthly_bps.description: Monthly interest in basis points (0 for products).

metadata.description: Merchant metadata, parsed to an object when it was valid JSON.

payment_url.description: Public payment URL: the storefront product page, or pay.depixapp.com/c/{id} for a charge.

recurrence.description: Recurrence (charges; null = one-time, and for products).
